response.sql: WITH gender_counts AS (SELECT c.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS invoiced_orders FROM Customers AS c JOIN Orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN Invoices AS i ON i.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY c.gender), overall AS (SELECT AVG(invoiced_orders * 1.0) AS per_gender_average FROM gender_counts) SELECT AVG(gc.invoiced_orders * 1.0) AS average_invoiced_orders, AVG(gc.invoiced_orders - o.per_gender_average) AS average_excess FROM gender_counts AS gc CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE gc.invoiced_orders > o.per_gender_average
